recognize_zh: 中央有一顆特別巨大的原紅血球（染色質細緻、胞質藍灰），周圍滿是大型原紅血球與棋盤狀染色質的紅血球母細胞，只有少數分葉嗜中性球，是紅血球系母細胞為主的骨髓。
features: Sheets of large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderately basophilic cytoplasm
A giant atypical erythroid precursor in the center with abundant cytoplasm and very large nucleus
Numerous maturing erythroblasts with coarsely clumped, checkered chromatin
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; rare segmented neutrophils
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly erythroid-predominant population. Large proerythroblasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm are abundant, including a giant atypical form, and are accompanied by numerous basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts with clumped chromatin. Granulocytes are infrequent. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Giant pronormoblasts in parvovirus contain glassy intranuclear inclusions and occur in a marrow depleted of later erythroid stages, unlike the abundant maturing erythroblasts here.
Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly erythroid maturation with asynchrony plus giant myeloid forms, without a proerythroblast excess.
Megakaryoblasts and dysplastic megakaryocytes are CD61/CD42b positive, whereas erythroid cells express CD71, glycophorin A and E-cadherin.
